text:
maria: Quick thought — can we try moving the weekly triage from 10:00am PDT to 3:00pm PDT starting next week? It would avoid the post-deploy scramble and open a short slot for RFC/design quick reviews.

sahil: +1 from me. Afternoon is safer for on-call overlap. Can we make it 35m instead of 50m? Shorter is better for async followups.

alex: 3pm PDT is rough for EU folks (11pm CET). Any way to alternate? Maybe afternoon for NA weeks and morning UTC for EU-heavy weeks?

kat: I like the idea of adding a 10m "RFC lightning" slot. Agenda could be: 10m hot bugs, 10m owner assignment, 10m RFC lightning, 5m followups. Keeps it timeboxed.

jordan: I can own rotating owner assignment for the next 4 weeks if we want to trial the rotation. I'll put my name down.

maria: Awesome — Jordan, could you draft a rotation table? Also ok to test 35m block next week. If it works we can formalize.

jordan: Will do. Drafting now.

maria: Proposed agenda snippet:

```
00:00 - Quick queue scrub (5m)
05:00 - Hotbug lane triage (10m)
15:00 - Owner assignments & followups (10m)
25:00 - RFC lightning (5m)
30:00 - Wrap / async tasks (5m)
```

sahil: Can we add a one-line field in the calendar invite: "Owner = person who checked the queue in the last 24h"? Makes expectations clear.

infra-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.example.com/event/abcd1234 — new time 15:00 PDT weekly. (automated)

alex: If we're alternating for EU weeks, I'd suggest marking those on the invite series so timezone conversion shows correctly. Also +1 to 35m/test.

maria: Thanks everyone. Jordan — toss rotation table and I'll update the invite notes with the owner rule. We'll flip next Monday and gather feedback mid-week. :thumbsup:
